subject: Re: Air freight quote request: HAM to BOG
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Our buyer has withdrawn the order, so we need to cancel the shipment. Please do not proceed with the booking. If you have already booked the shipment, please cancel the booking.

I apologise for the inconvenience.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer says the order was withdrawn and asks to cancel the shipment rather than proceed with the quoted booking.
